name: Serena Bloodfeather
summary: Across the northern Barrens, harpy attacks threaten the Crossroads supply lines. Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing flock against the Horde, driven by vengeance for her sister, whom Rexxar slew during Durotar’s founding. Breaking the flock’s coordination could open the trails again.

sections.title: A Legacy of Vengeance
sections.body: Witchwing harpies strike the trails northwest of the Crossroads under Serena Bloodfeather’s command. Hunger is not their only cause. Serena seeks vengeance against the Horde for her sister, the notorious matriarch Bloodfeather, whom the beastmaster Rexxar slew during Durotar’s founding. Now Serena rallies her flock against supply trains, scouts, and merchants on the arid trails.

sections.title: Cutting Off the Head
sections.body: Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads has led the effort against the harpies, from petty raiders to seasoned lieutenants. Now he calls for Serena’s head as proof of her death and a trophy for the next outgoing caravan. The Horde hopes the surviving harpies will see their matriarch’s fate and fear to return to the Barrens’ supply lines.

faq.q: Why is Serena Bloodfeather attacking Horde caravans?
faq.answer: Serena attacks Horde caravans to avenge her sister. During Durotar’s founding, the beastmaster Rexxar slew Bloodfeather, and Serena now turns her flock against Horde supply wagons and travelers.

Bloodfeather was a notorious harpy leader who terrorized the borders of Durotar and the Barrens. Rexxar slew her while serving Warchief Thrall. Her surviving sister Serena took up her mantle and grudge.

faq.q: Why does Darsok Swiftdagger want her head?
faq.answer: Darsok wants Serena’s head to confirm her death and display it on an outgoing caravan wagon. He hopes the sight will warn surviving harpies away from Horde supply lines.

faq.q: Where can Serena Bloodfeather be found?
faq.answer: Serena can be found among the rugged cliffs and wind-carved crags northwest of the Crossroads, surrounded by Witchwing lieutenants and guards.

faq.q: What happens after Serena is defeated?
faq.answer: After Serena falls, Darsok sends reliable mercenaries to help other allies in need. He dispatches them with a letter to Jin'Zil, the witch doctor in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc scout stationed at the Crossroads, assigns the bounty. He oversees efforts against wild threats along trade routes and issues it after the flock’s lower ranks have been cleared.

angles.text: The northern trade routes through the Crossroads supply orcish outposts and connect Durotar with Mulgore and Stonetalon. Putting down organized harpy raiders keeps those routes open.
As a rogue, you’ll find Darsok Swiftdagger values cold efficiency. He calls for Serena’s throat to be slit swiftly, without a prolonged fight.
As an orc, you face unfinished business tied to Rexxar’s deeds and the fierce struggles on Durotar’s early frontier.
